title: Disentangling Steering Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2609.07037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time approach to control the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, traditional steering vectors used to intervene in LLMs' activations, such as those derived from the difference-in-means method, tend to entangle multiple semantic and stylistic concepts into a single composite direction, leading to unpredictable steering effects. Our core objective is to disentangle this composite direction into its constituent concepts. To this end, we propose Steering Vector Dissection, a framework to explicitly isolate individual and semantically consistent features from these composite directions. Specifically, we pair positive and negative activations and take their differences to generate a set of instance-level steering vectors, and train a dedicated Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) directly on them. Quantitative evaluations across two datasets, two models, and two intervention depths

translated_abstract: 激活引导已成为一种轻量级的推理时方法，用于控制大语言模型（LLM）的行为。然而，传统用于干预LLM激活的转向向量，例如通过均值差方法得到的向量，往往将多个语义和风格概念纠缠到单一复合方向中，导致不可预测的引导效果。我们的核心目标是将该复合方向解耦为其组成的各个概念。为此，我们提出了转向向量解剖，一个从这些复合方向中显式分离出单个且语义一致特征的框架。具体而言，我们将正激活和负激活进行配对并取其差异，生成一组实例级转向向量，并直接在其上训练一个专用的稀疏自编码器（SAE）。在两个数据集、两个模型和两个干预深度上的定量评估……
tldr: 该论文提出“转向向量解剖”框架，通过在正负激活差生成的实例级转向向量上训练稀疏自编码器，将复合转向向量中纠缠的多个语义和风格概念解耦分离，从而实现对大语言模型行为更可预测的精准引导。
